Definition: Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Bethuel means "God destroys." The name is shared by several bearers: Nephew of Abraham, son of Nahor by Milcah, father of Rebekah; A town of Simeon in the south. It turns up in Genesis 22:22, Genesis 22:23 and Genesis 24:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bethuel matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
